first.rationale: I currently intend to test a shorter, simpler onboarding flow because onboarding completion is down 4% and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding improved completion and time-to-value, while signup simplification improved SMB activation. I will verify the onboarding and activation records before committing. Use a limited test with explicit stop conditions on qualified activation, retained usage, and pipeline or revenue quality so a superficial completion lift does not mask downstream value loss. Promotional pricing may address competitor pressure but carries known 30-day retention risk, making it less aligned with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding simplification experiment, prioritizing the current 4% completion decline and the confirmed prior result of +13% completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and +3% 30-day retention. This is better aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, which previously hurt retention. Monitor qualified activation, retained usage, and revenue quality—not completion alone—with predefined stop conditions if downstream metrics deteriorate.
